_help: Edit this file, then run: npm run build:site. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Fill in contact.whatsapp (country code + number, digits only), your brand name and your prices. Text marked as a promise (delivery, edits, how long the link stays online) is a placeholder: change it to what you really offer. Prices are suggested starting points (see docs/LANDING-PAGE.md): change them any time.

seo.title: Animated wedding invitations for WhatsApp | Invitation Studio

items.q: How do guests open the invitation?
items.a: They tap the link you send on WhatsApp. It opens in the phone's browser with no app and no login. They tap the seal or lotus, then scroll through the card.

items.q: Will it work on every phone?
items.a: It works on current iPhones and Android phones, and on computers. If a phone has Reduce Motion switched on, the card still works with calmer animations.
Into a Google Sheet that you own. Each reply shows the guest's name, answer, number of guests and any note.

items.q: Can strangers find the invitation online?
items.a: No. Invitation links are hidden from search engines, so only the people you send the link to will find it.

items.q: Can we use our own photos and music?
items.a: Yes. Send three portrait photos you have permission to use. For music, send the song you would like and confirm you have the right to use it.

items.q: Can something be changed after I approve?
items.a: Yes. After you approve, message us what to change and we will update the same link.

items.q: How long does the link stay online?
items.a: The link stays live well after the wedding. Ask us when you book and we will confirm the exact period.
